title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions

result.label: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
result.statement: Proves the finite-rational-coefficient form of Shokurov’s bounded-klt-complement conjecture for ϵ -lc complex Fano-type pairs with nef anti-log-canonical divisor. For ϵ -lc Fano contractions over any algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, it gives klt complements near every base point, with index bounded only by dimension and positive rational ϵ .
